name: Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 19, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Employee Recognition Award
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
8.
SCHEDULE A DATE AND TIME FOR THE FY 2016-2017 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND FY 2016-2017 BUDGET PUBLIC HEARING
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Select one of the following dates for the FY 2016-2017 Budget Workshop: Tuesday, May 31, 2016 at 6:00 p.m.
Wednesday, June 1, 2016 at 6:00 p.m.
Thursday, June 2, 2016 at 6:00 p.m.
2)
Schedule the FY 2016-2017 Budget Public Hearing on Tuesday, June 21, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Item #8
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting on April 5, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2016-13 Approving the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Professional Services Agreement with DAC to perform consulting services to prepare an ADA self-evaluation and transition plan for the City of Lomita
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to sign an agreement with Disability Access Consultants (DAC) to perform ADA self-evaluation and transition plan for the City of Lomita.
Item #7d
e.
An Ordinance establishing Chapter 5 of Title V, Construction and Demolition and adoption of the appeal fee resolution
Ord No. 779 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, establishing a new Chapter 5 of Title V, Construction and Demolition Waste Management. (Second Reading)
Res. No. 2016-14 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, establishing performance security amounts for Construction and Demolition Waste Management Plan applications.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt an ordinance establishing Chapter 5 of Title V, Construction and Demolition Waste Management and approve the attached appeal fee resolution.
Item #7e
f.
Consider and adopt a Resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2016-17
Res No. 2016-15 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, declaring the intent of the City Council to levy and collect assessments within the Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2016 and ending June 30, 2017, and setting a public hearing date of May 17, 2016.
Res. No. 2016-16 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, ordering the Public Works Director/City Engineer to prepare and file the Engineer's Report for Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, in accordance with the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972, being Division 15, Part 2 of the Streets and Highways Code of the State of California, for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2016 to and ending June 30, 2017.
Item #7f
g.
Approve Amendment No. 2 for Street Sweeping Services with R.F. Dickson Company, Inc.
ACTION: That the City Council approve a Second Amendment to the Agreement for street sweeping services with R.F. Dickson, Inc. extending the term of the Amendment for a period of three (3) months through June 30, 2016, and increasing the compensation by 3.1%; and that the City Manager be authorized to sign Amendment No. 2.
Item #7g
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
10.
Commission/Board appointments for two vacancies and one expired term: (1) Public Safety and Traffic Commission and (1) on Railroad Museum Board and (1) expired term on the Parks and Recreation Commission.
11.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn in Memory of Shirley Jones Pettit, Robert L. Hoppes and Chialing Chuang.
9.
Consideration and possible action to adopt Resolution No. 2016-17, A
Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita authorizing the execution and delivery by the City of an Indenture of Trust, an Escrow Agreement and a Term Sheet in connection with the issuance of Water Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series 2016, approving the issuance of such bonds in an aggregate principal amount of not to exceed $7,500,000 and authorizing the execution of necessary documents and certificates and related actions.
Item #9
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
